name: Petra Tart Cherry Mints [40pk] (100mg THC)
description:
This robust, delectable flavor is like picking a ripe, tart cherry straight off the vine. This product does not contain any allergens. 5mg THC per serving 100mg THC per package 40 mints per pack

Ingredients: Xylitol, Dextrin, Malic Acid, Citric Acid, Natural Flavors, Rebiana (Stevia), Fruit & Vegetable Juice for Color, Cannabis Extract, Magnesium Stearate, Silicon Dioxide, Vegetable Oil. Made in a facility that processes milk, nuts, soy and gluten.
